title_en: A maiden and a young man were speaking

lines.en: A maiden and a young man were speaking,
speaking, even whispering:
– Tell me, my love, tell me,
when will we have our wedding?

lines.cyr: Шепни лудо, срце да чуе што збориш,
lines.lat: Šepni ludo, srce da čue što zboriš,
lines.en: Whisper wildly, so my heart can hear what you say,

lines.cyr: шепни лудо, срце за тебе ќе ми изгори.
lines.lat: šepni ludo, srce za tebe ḱe mi izgori.
lines.en: whisper wildly, my heart will burn for you.
The young man speaks to the maiden:
– Wait, my love, wait,
we haven’t gathered the vineyards,
we have no rakija nor wine.

lines.cyr: Шепни лудо, срце да чуе што збориш,
lines.lat: Šepni ludo, srce da čue što zboriš,
lines.en: Whisper wildly, so my heart can hear what you say,

lines.cyr: шепни лудо, срце за тебе ќе ми изгори.
lines.lat: šepni ludo, srce za tebe ḱe mi izgori.
lines.en: whisper wildly, my heart will burn for you.
The maiden speaks to the young man:
– I cannot wait, my love,
tonight the matchmakers are coming,

lines.cyr: за друго момче ќе м' омажат.
lines.lat: za drugo momče ḱe m' omažat.
lines.en: they will marry me to another boy.

lines.cyr: Шепни лудо, срце да чуе што збориш,
lines.lat: Šepni ludo, srce da čue što zboriš,
lines.en: Whisper wildly, so my heart can hear what you say,

lines.cyr: шепни лудо, срце за тебе ќе ми изгори.
lines.lat: šepni ludo, srce za tebe ḱe mi izgori.
lines.en: whisper wildly, my heart will burn for you.
The young man speaks to the maiden:

lines.cyr: - На други јас не те давам,
lines.lat: - Na drugi jas ne te davam,
lines.en: – I will not give you to another,
prepare your home by tonight,
I am coming with the matchmakers.

lines.cyr: Шепни лудо, срце да чуе што збориш,
lines.lat: Šepni ludo, srce da čue što zboriš,
lines.en: Whisper wildly, so my heart can hear what you say,

lines.cyr: шепни лудо, срце за тебе ќе ми изгори.
lines.lat: šepni ludo, srce za tebe ḱe mi izgori.
lines.en: whisper wildly, my heart will burn for you.
